title: After the Japanese Derby: Positive Words

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon wins the Japanese Derby. In the midst of the applause, she officially challenges Rice Shower, acknowledging her as her biggest rival in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd goes wild. On the other hand…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser expresses her disappointment at the post-race press conference, but still shows enthusiasm for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her optimism at the press conference touches the hearts of viewers. As with every other race, Matikanetannhauser is heading to the Kikuka Sho with the intent to win.
